card.name: Spaces before subscripts and list starts
card.fires_on: Spaces or small words in labels just before a subscript number (5-HT 3, g/m 2) or right after a colon or 'A' that opens a list item such as 'A history of'.

modes.label: Space before subscript
modes.description: A blank space between a unit or name and a following small number, such as 5-HT or m followed by 2.

modes.label: Word after list lead-in
modes.description: The first word after a colon or 'A' that introduces a contraindication or check item.
modes.example: UPLIZNA is contraindicated in patients with: A<< history>> of a life-threatening infusion reaction

modes.label: Dose per area spacing
modes.description: The space between m and the superscript 2 in doses per square meter.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of tretinoin capsules is 22.5 mg/m<< >>2 orally twice daily

card.writes: It slightly favors text-continuing marks like ellipses and quotes and disfavors line-ending punctuation, so the text goes on.
card.plain: It fires on odd small gaps and list-opening words where the sentence is clearly going to continue.
